Definition: from G1909 and G2523; to seat upon:--set on.
BiblicalUsage: Epikathizo means to set upon — and the disciples bring the ass and the colt, put their clothes on them, and set Jesus thereon, as He rides into Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: No throne, no crown, only a borrowed colt and cloaks — and the King rides in anyway, and that is the coronation in miniature.
